tools.name: search_documentation_corpus
tools.description: Search the documentation corpus for passages matching a natural language query. This tool performs hybrid retrieval over the indexed documentation, combining a dense vector search with a sparse keyword index, and returns the highest scoring passages together with their source document identifiers and section headings. Use it whenever the user asks a question whose answer is likely to be written down somewhere in the product documentation rather than something you already know. Prefer a specific query over a broad one, and narrow the scope when the user has clearly indicated which part of the documentation they mean.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: the natural language query to search for, phrased as the user would

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: maximum number of passages to return, between 1 and 50

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: restrict the search to one section of the documentation

parameters.name: rerank
parameters.description: whether to re-score the shortlist with a cross-encoder

parameters.name: min_score
parameters.description: discard passages scoring below this threshold
